correctness.rationale: In the stated \(n\ge3,m\ge1\) domain, the normal-basis coordinate argument proves a bijection between solutions of \(Bv^{[2]}=v\) and \(\ker_{\mathbb F_2}(B^m-I)\), without requiring nonsingularity. The adjacency of an undirected cycle is \(S+S^{-1}\); multiplication by \(P_m\) in \(\mathbb F_2[X]/(X^n-1)\) has kernel dimension exactly the gcd degree, even for repeated factors. Since \(P_m=P_r^{2^s}\) and odd \(P_r\) is squarefree by \(P_r'=X^{r-1}\), saturation iff \(2^s o_r\mid n\) and least-period minimality follow. The embedded checker passed 480 independent binary-matrix pairs, 19 direct finite-field enumerations, and 642 period tests; the proof is general.

originality.rationale: A complete claim-to-prior implication comparison was made. Khudoyberdiyev–Omirov–Qaralleh classify one-target permutation evolution-algebra constructions, not two-neighbor graph cycles. Elduque–Labra define graph-associated evolution algebras and prove results about nilpotency and automorphisms; they do not give idempotent-element counts. Sriwongsa–Zou study automorphism groups and the different property \(E^2=E\). Kaygorodov–Martín González–Viruel treat general idempotent systems and perfect-algebra scheme degrees, not this singular graph family. Dempwolff–Fisher–Herman provide standard invertible-semilinear normal forms; the graph adjacency here is singular, and their work does not calculate the cycle gcd/period invariant. Related published mathematical-record hits concern existence of nonzero idempotents in 2D perfect algebras or character degrees of other cycle graphical groups, so neither implies the theorem. No equivalent cycle census was located, but unseen indirect semilinear/graph literature is a real residual risk.
residual_risks: A yet-unlocated general noninvertible semilinear fixed-point enumeration could yield the normal-basis count and simplify the cycle specialization.
Undiscovered research on graph evolution algebra equilibrium states could tabulate or imply the same exact gcd/least-period result.
The normal-basis lemma and elementary recurrence bound are standard; only the full cycle-polynomial two-parameter census and exact arithmetic least period are claimed as the proposed contribution.

value.rationale: A natural algebraic equilibrium/idempotent count is determined for all undirected cycles and every characteristic-two extension field by a bounded-degree polynomial gcd. The sharp \(2^{2m}\) bound does not grow with cycle length, and the precisely classified maximizing lengths have least period \(2^{v_2(m)}o_{m/2^{v_2(m)}}\), with field-sensitive three- and five-cycle resonances. This is an infinite two-parameter exact classification with a structural arithmetic explanation; no arbitrary finite slice or conjectural downstream consequence is needed.
